method: Existing Google Cloud Translation draft with agent corrections and independent AI review; no human/native-speaker validation
notes: Independently compared all 194 fields against the frozen English source: marketing, gameplay, community, download instructions, navigation, accessible controls and media descriptions.

Corrected colony-to-livestock drift, national flags versus game orders, hostile pronoun register, inn/swarm building captions, Wikipedia versus original wiki, tutorial versus classroom cooking, portable ZIP versus mobile edition and software releases versus press releases. Preserved native quán trọ/tổ building vocabulary and restored exact savefile and store-release qualifications.
Verified complete keys/placeholders and exact executable command, file names and screenshot counters. Preserved early-access, guest/ranked sign-in, browser-save and signing-key qualifications.
AI linguistic review only; no human/native-speaker validation. Native editorial review can further refine idiom and terminology.
